The chandelier already sold the working 1.0 share that morning at $53.04 (forced, resting_stop_breached, realized -0.54R vs $55.144 cost). Five SELL_TO_CLOSE attempts on 2026-08-19 came back rejected_no_position; this is a retry to clean that leftover now that pre-market is open, not a discretionary cut of a working thesis. Fiscal Q3 is still due 2026-09-02; I am not re-entering.
